title: Notification deck
description: Expand stacked notifications without losing their order or origin.
useCase: Expand stacked notifications without losing their order or origin.
interaction: Expand the stack or dismiss a notice
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Local notification stack. Use your application’s notification service for delivery, persistence, and live announcements.
look: Pale blue-grey page with one white rounded notification card over two peeking cards, a soft green icon tile, and a faint rounded button below.
motion: Hovering the deck or pressing the control spreads the cards from 10 px to 60 px offsets, restoring full scale and opacity over 250 ms ease-out; dismissing restacks the rest.
adapt: Each `.notice` gets an inline `transform` from `expanded` (`i * 60` spread, `i * 10` and `1 - i * 0.04` collapsed), eased by its 250 ms CSS transition. Replace the hard-coded `items` strings and their icon and timestamp lookups.
